prompts.prompt: Before changing this loom workflow, check whether docs/loom/memory has a lesson about stale review markers.
prompts.expected_behavior: Checks whether the repo adopted the memory store, follows its charter, recalls matching entries pull-first, and reports freshness or contradictions.

prompts.prompt: Save this lesson to loom memory, but this repository has no docs/loom/memory directory.
prompts.expected_behavior: Returns a loud N/A instead of creating or assuming the store, because the skill is conditional on repository adoption.

prompts.prompt: Clean up loom memory: delete anything redundant or outdated automatically.
prompts.expected_behavior: Produces exhaustive keep/merge/retire proposals with contradiction handling and integrity checks, but never deletes without approval.
